global.reducedMotionFallback: Disable smooth scroll, 3D canvas, parallax and marquee; keep instant opacity fades only.

sequence: logo mark strokes draw in (SVG stroke-dashoffset)

onScroll.state: glass: backdrop-blur 14px, surface 70% opacity, 1px bottom border, height 88→68px

megaMenu.enter: clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) → inset(0), items stagger 0.03s y:8→0

header.ctaButton: magnetic hover (max 8px pull) + gradient border sweep

background.scrollDepth: camera dollies back 20% as hero scrolls out
background.fallback: static gradient + CSS noise when WebGL unavailable or reduced motion

slideTransition.media: clip-path circle reveal from cursor/centre + scale 1.12→1 over 1.4s
slideTransition.title: split into words, each masked, y:110%→0 stagger 0.06s
slideTransition.subtitle: fade up 0.3s after title

hero.pagination: vertical progress bars on right edge, fill = autoplay progress
hero.scrollCue: animated mouse icon, dot bounces 1.6s loop

commitment.effect: two columns slide in from opposite sides, icons draw-in

stats.effect: count-up numbers over 1.8s outExpo, underline grows

solutionsCarousel.cardHover: 3D tilt (max 8deg), image zoom 1.08, glow border, icon lifts 4px

solutionsGridPage.effect: sticky left title, cards pin-scroll horizontally on desktop (GSAP ScrollTrigger pin)

partners.effect: infinite marquee 40s, pause on hover, logos grayscale→colour on hover, edge fade masks

projects.filter: sector chips with shared-layout underline (Framer Motion layoutId)
projects.cardHover: image reveal via clip-path, metrics slide up

timeline.effect: SVG line draws with scroll progress; milestone dots pop at intersection

contact.effect: form fields float-label; submit button morphs to spinner → check

footer.effect: large wordmark parallax at 0.3 speed, links underline slide

micro.buttons: hover: background slide from left 0.3s; press: scale 0.97

cursor.style: small dot + trailing ring that grows over interactive elements

performanceBudget.threeLazyLoad: dynamic import after first paint; skip entirely below 768px if device memory < 4 GB
